notes.title: Major Update: Solo Gunship Mode Launches with Two New Maps!
notes.content: [p]Major Game Update! Solo Fun + Two New Maps Now Live![/p][p]No more waiting for teammates! The brand-new Solo AC130 Gunship Mode is finally unlocked — a rescue helicopter has crashed due to mechanical failure, trapped by a horde of zombies, and the command center has urgently dispatched an AC130 gunship for support! Now you’ll take the helm of the AC130 yourself, unleash heavy fire to suppress the zombie tide, and defend the crash site until rescue arrives. Experience the intense thrill of hardcore aerial combat even when playing solo![/p][p]Two brand-new maps are also launching simultaneously, taking the gameplay to the next level:[/p][p]Massive Open-Exploration Map: Dive into a factory to search for 100 key supplies. The map is extremely vast — remember to make good use of drone air-to-ground support, and watch out for getting lost in the expansive terrain![/p][p]Doomsday Freight Yard: A zombie-infested area shrouded in thick fog, brimming with immersive atmosphere. Danger lurks around every corner, delivering a heart-pounding immersive doomsday survival experience![/p][p]We’ll keep updating the game with more content and unlocking new gameplay features in the future! Thank you to every player for your attention and support — come and start your new doomsday battle now![/p]

notes.title: Algorithm upgrade enables a 50% performance surge.
Optimized the visual effects, increased the frame rate, and enhanced
notes.content: [p]Optimized the visual effects, increased the frame rate, and enhanced the smoothness of the game.[/p]

notes.title: Updated the Predator Drone. Added a new map.
notes.content: [p]New Additions[/p][p]New Aerial Unit: Predator Drone[/p][p]A brand-new aerial combat asset joins the fray – the Predator Drone, ready to provide heavy firepower support on the battlefield.[/p][p]New Map: Misty World[/p][p]Introducing the all-new map Misty World! Featuring a massive open environment, fresh gameplay mechanics, and an immersive post-apocalyptic setting, this map offers endless exploration and strategic challenges.[/p][p]New Weapon: QBZ191 Assault Rifle[/p][p]Arm yourself with the newly added QBZ191 Assault Rifle, boasting faster fire rates and more powerful damage to dominate every skirmish.[/p][p]Predator Drone in Single Player Mode[/p][p]The Predator Drone is now available in single-player mode too, enriching solo gameplay with enhanced tactical options.[/p][p]New Pinging System[/p][p]A new pinging system has been added to enable more precise air-ground coordination, boosting teamwork and interactivity during battles.[/p][p]First Workshop Map: Abandoned Factory 3[/p][p]After technical testing, the first community-created workshop map Abandoned Factory 3, developed by creator "Hai Ren," is now live in multiplayer mode. Dive into this reimagined industrial battlefield![/p][p]Optimizations[/p][p]Improved overall game smoothness for a more fluid experience.[/p][p]Fixed the rare "teleportation bug" that occasionally occurred.[/p][p]Optimized network stability for multiplayer matches, reducing lag.[/p][p]Increased gold rewards in post-match 结算 (post-battle rewards).[/p][p]Fixed various other minor bugs to polish gameplay.[/p]

notes.title: AC130 Zombie Gunship Update Announcement
notes.content: [h2]AC130 Zombie Gunship Update Announcement[/h2][p]Dear Survivors,[/p][p]The latest game update has been successfully completed. Here are the key changes:[/p][p]New text chat system: Press the "Y" key to open the text chat box for easier communication.[/p][p]Fixed known bugs: Addressed issues such as occasional scene lag and operational anomalies reported by players, further optimizing game stability for a smoother combat experience.[/p][p]We will continue to listen to your feedback and keep improving the game. If you encounter any problems, please feel free to contact us through official channels. Wish you all smooth progress in the battle against zombies![/p][p]AC130 Zombie Gunship Official Team[/p]

notes.title: A revised map is added. Two new firearms are introduced.
notes.content: [p]A revised map is added. Two new firearms are introduced.[/p][p]The Abandoned Factory 2 map features both day and night modes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629120/e9a025085517f73f7a248df924a9420d6272b8f3.png"][/img][/p][p]Audio is optimized, and the gunshot bug is fixed.[/p][p]The smoothness of the two Crash Site maps is improved.[/p][p]The clue mode is optimized: generated items are prevented from being unsearchable due to flipping.[/p][p]The weapons and equipment of ground personnel are enhanced, including the MP7 and Scar assault rifle.[/p][p]An AK-series firearm and a designated marksman rifle are added.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629120/17e0a6213f48513144ac5dd78e9a811bc04562de.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629120/df69cdfa96d4d772f2fe6cffdb1dd5c50aaa96e6.png"][/img][/p][p]The shaking issue of designated marksman rifles when scoped in is fixed.[/p][p]The screen shaking of ground personnel caused by aerial gunboats is reduced.[/p]

notes.title: Thank you all for your timely feedback on the bug issues! We have completed the
notes.content: [p]Thank you all for your timely feedback! We have completed emergency fixes for the issues that appeared in the game recently. The specific update contents are as follows:[/p][p]Added hit feedback to enhance operational feel.[/p][p]Increased the bullet flight speed of Weapon 1 on the aerial gunboat.[/p][p]Optimized 画面 details, improved smoothness and frame rate, bringing a more stable visual experience.[/p][p]Fixed the bug where the mouse pops out to the desktop to ensure operational continuity.[/p][p]Resolved the issues of helicopter stuttering and sudden appearance, and optimized vehicle performance.[/p][p]Fixed the bugs of unsmooth running actions, stuttering and inability to run, making character movement more fluid.[/p][p]Enhanced the survival ability of ground players![/p][p]Fixed the bug where the game closes directly when a player exits the room, and optimized the exit process.[/p][p]We will continue to pay attention to everyone's feedback and make every effort to ensure the gaming experience! Thank you for your understanding and support, and wish you a pleasant game![/p]
